title: Historical nominal mode comparison
scope: Historical nominal TT measurements, before automatic PVT repair and optional SNR assessment. Modes share a policy; they are search strategies, not separately trained models.
timestamp_note: Snapshot built 2026-09-10. Historical run; not a claim for the current integrated pipeline. Fastest row updated 2026-09-10 from a full 32-case rerun (scratchpad/fastest_full32.json) after a stage-1 corpus-seed retry fix (surrogate_stage1 now tries up to 4 successive nearest corpus seeds on guard-invalid instead of 1); the other four modes are unchanged and still reflect the original mode_bench5.json sweep. Fastest's median runtime also reflects an unrelated ngspice shared-library fix (destroy-all-plots per eval, applied in this repo since this snapshot's original build) that removed a resident-process slowdown affecting all modes equally when re-measured -- do not read the runtime drop as evidence the retry itself got faster.
error_definition: Median absolute target-boost error across cases with a reported finite measurement. Unmeasured cases are counted separately.
solve_definition: Recorded solved status and passed flag. Non-solve rate is not bit error rate.
chance_definition: Spec-blind empirical target-hit estimate matched to each case's optimizer evaluation budget. It does not check all physical constraints, is not a p-value and is not evidence of physical infeasibility.
